name: Network Flow Analysis
description: Ability to analyse network flow data (NetFlow, IPFIX, Zeek logs) for forensic investigations. Covers identifying communication patterns, data exfiltration, lateral movement, beaconing behaviour, and anomalous traffic volumes without requiring full packet captures.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to network flow analysis

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands what network flow data is and how it differs from full packet capture
evidence: Can explain the difference between flow data and full packet capture
Understands NetFlow/IPFIX record fields and what they represent
Can describe scenarios where flow analysis is preferable to PCAP analysis

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Queries and analyses flow data to answer basic investigative questions under supervision
evidence: Queried NetFlow or Zeek conn.log data to identify communication partners for a given host
Identified high-volume data transfers and unusual port usage in flow data under guidance
Used flow query tools (SiLK, nfdump) to summarise and explore traffic patterns
Documented flow analysis findings with supervisor review

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently analyses flow data to detect lateral movement, exfiltration, and beaconing in investigations
evidence: Independently used flow analysis in 5+ forensic investigations
Detected beaconing patterns and C2 communication intervals from flow data
Identified data exfiltration by volume, timing, and destination analysis
Correlated flow data with other evidence sources to establish attacker movement

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles large-scale flow analysis across enterprise networks; develops detection analytics; performs statistical traffic analysis
evidence: Analysed flow data across large enterprise networks (thousands of hosts) efficiently
Developed automated beaconing and exfiltration detection scripts or queries
Applied statistical methods to identify anomalous traffic patterns in flow data
Mentors analysts on flow analysis techniques and tooling

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines flow analysis methodology; develops analytics frameworks; recognised authority in network forensic flow analysis
evidence: Authored or maintains the lab's network flow analysis methodology
Developed flow analysis frameworks or tooling used across the lab
Published research on flow-based forensic analysis techniques
Trains teams on flow analysis and network forensic triage

assessment_methods.description: Given a week of flow data from a compromised network, identify lateral movement, beaconing, and exfiltration activity
Review flow analysis sections from recent investigation reports for analytical rigour and completeness
